description.value:
Cleverly designed nanoparticles replace your hands or similar appendages. In their inactive state, they resemble normal hands, but they can transform with a single Interact action into a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.Infiltrator's Toolkit (Tactical)]{tactical infiltrator's toolkit}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.Maker's Toolkit (Tactical)]{tactical maker's toolkit}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.Repair Toolkit (Tactical)]{tactical repair toolkit}. The item bonus granted by the tactical toolkits produced by the augmentation increases to +2.

Activate—Self-correct r (manipulate)

Frequency once per hour

Trigger You critically fail a Crafting or Thievery check while your quantum multitool appendage is transformed

Effect The onboard AI partly corrects your error, turning the triggering critical failure into a failure.
